versions.changelog:
Initial release of the fable-dev skill.  
- Provides comprehensive development guidance for the Fable app (Electron + React creative-writing software).
- Details architecture, coding conventions, code placement, and shared code constraints.
- Explains data access patterns, key directories, and common development task recipes.
- Lists best practices, pitfalls to avoid, and required i18n procedures.
- Includes build, lint, test instructions, path aliasing, and reference materials.
